shots.method: Live-action counter plate with product cut-out and kinetic type.
shots.fallback_method: Static pack-on-counter still with a slow push-in and type fade.

shots.method: Real-time overhead food demonstration, one continuous take.
shots.fallback_method: Stop-motion of the same steps at two frames per action.

shots.method: Macro live-action pour at 50 fps, finished at 25 fps.
shots.fallback_method: Still macro pour plate with animated steam and a slow scale.

shots.method: Product stills with a four-pack fan and a single camera move.
shots.fallback_method: Captured four-pack still on the same counter with a slow scale; keep the light and dark endpoints.

shots.method: Finished-cup live action with a time-lapse transition.
shots.fallback_method: Still cup with animated steam and a type-only time card.

shots.method: End-card composite with supplied logo and pack.
shots.fallback_method: Typographic end card with logo, scaled Mixed Bag pack and CTA; the pack remains mandatory even if the hero image is unavailable.

assets.name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters logo
assets.specification: PNG, transparency. Use the largest available master; do not upscale a thumbnail.

assets.name: Easy Pour Mixed Bag pack
assets.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800. Crop only to the pack edge; do not crop the front label.

assets.name: Easy Pour Vienna pack
assets.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800. Front pack only; keep the roast descriptor visible.

assets.name: Easy Pour Attikan Estate pack
assets.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800. Front pack only; keep the roast descriptor visible.

assets.name: Easy Pour brewing demonstration, hands
assets.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160. Shoot 4K for a 1080p master crop; 180-degree shutter.

assets.name: Hot water pour and bloom footage
assets.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160. Source timebase 50 fps; conform to the 25 fps master at 50 percent speed.

assets.name: Finished cup of coffee
assets.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160. Shoot 4K; keep the cup rim and coffee surface in focus.

assets.name: Voice over, warm Indian English
assets.specification: WAV. 48 kHz, 24-bit, dry studio recording; full 20-second read.

assets.name: Easy Pour Seethargundu Estate pack
assets.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800. Front pack only; keep the light-roast descriptor visible.
